name: LootBot xLoot staking redeem pays each duplicated NFT id in the input array
summary: LootBot Staking.redeem(uint256[] xloots) sums each listed xLoot NFT's unclaimed per-epoch ETH and only afterwards marks the ids redeemed, without rejecting repeated ids. The attacker passed one or a few owned ids hundreds of times per call; later it flash-borrowed ETH to open a new epoch and redeemed the duplicated ids again.
notes: Loss counts only the excess over the attacker's rightful single-copy entitlement per xLoot id: payout x (n-1)/n for the April 8 calls, and for the April 15 call the net outflow (after its own 2.1 ETH epoch deposit) minus payout/155.
Later redeems by other accounts list distinct ids and are ordinary claims.
